reasons: Nothing here is tested, though a wrong path would show up when the app starts.

terms.meaning: passing something from another file on, so it can be imported from this file.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Re-exports of shared components
sections.what: Passes on the card, button, tag, badge, avatar, heading, divider and empty-state components from their own files.
sections.why: Likely reason: one import path for several components.
sections.watch_out: A component missing from this list cannot be imported from here.

summary: A single entry point that passes along the shared UI components.
purpose: Lets screens import several components from one path.
how: Re-exports the card, button and the small components from the atoms file.
outputs: The named components, ready to import.
risks: A new component that is not listed here cannot be imported from this path.
debug: If a screen cannot find a component, check that it is listed here and that the file name matches.
